name: frontleap-admin
description: Frontleap Platform Admin MCP server for a single Frontleap origin (Clerk OAuth at connect).

FRONTLEAP_URL.title: Frontleap origin
FRONTLEAP_URL.description: Public origin for the Frontleap app you are using (scheme + host only, no path, no trailing slash). Example: https://slug.frontleap.com. The plugin appends the fixed admin MCP path.
